# Project 6 - Adaptive Traffic Signal Optimization: Auto-generated Analysis

> Simulation-based findings only; not proof of real-world performance.

* Training records: 10,000; test scenarios: 1,000 per level x 3 levels
* Training episodes: 1000; seeds: 5

## Significance (Welch t-test on per-seed avg waiting time)

| comparison                |   mean_diff_wait_s |   t_stat |   p_value | significant_0_05   |
|:--------------------------|-------------------:|---------:|----------:|:-------------------|
| D3QN_PER vs A2C           |            -23.721 |   -4.319 |    0.0083 | True               |
| D3QN_PER vs Abl_noDouble  |             -1.654 |   -0.445 |    0.6723 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs Abl_noDueling |              0.985 |    0.28  |    0.7884 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs Abl_noPER     |              6.037 |    3.271 |    0.0188 | True               |
| D3QN_PER vs DDQN          |             -2.819 |   -0.435 |    0.6832 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs DQN           |             -1.767 |   -0.646 |    0.5373 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs DuelingDQN    |              0.778 |    0.135 |    0.8983 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs FixedTime     |            -65.931 |  -39.23  |    0      | True               |
| D3QN_PER vs MaxPressure   |             -3.09  |   -1.838 |    0.1394 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs PPO           |             -1.466 |   -0.722 |    0.4936 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs QLearning     |            -28.084 |   -2.041 |    0.1088 | False              |
| D3QN_PER vs SARSA         |            -35.965 |   -3.789 |    0.0172 | True               |
